title: Retail inventory methods have two other options: the LIFO retail method

items.concept: Initial application of LIFO retail — ending inventory at retail (average cost approach), base vs current cost ratios, layer valuation, and period-end COGS/inventory JE
Number-variant twin of LIFO retail layer valuation and period-end inventory/COGS recognition
Dollar-value LIFO retail layer schedule (price index × cost ratio); layer liquidation when base-year retail declines; adoption JE from conventional retail; classification/disclosure
Distinguishing LIFO retail vs conventional retail and identifying dollar-value LIFO retail measurement elements
